metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and mods by Laststance.io

plugins.name: always-expand
plugins.description: /expand toggles always-expanded rows: tool output and thinking shown in full, as ctrl+o shows them

plugins.name: blackout
plugins.description: Toggle with ctrl+space (or /blackout) to blank Claude Code's screen down to the terminal's own background, and back

plugins.name: desktop-notification
plugins.description: macOS desktop notification when Claude Code needs you (waiting for input, a permission prompt); clicking it brings your terminal to the front

plugins.name: open-in-editor
plugins.description: /vscode /cursor /devin-desktop /webstorm /phpstorm /zed open the session's project root in that editor (macOS)

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Keeps secrets out of the conversation: refuses shell commands that spell out a key or token, and masks secrets in tool results before Claude and the transcript get them

plugins.name: serena-activate
plugins.description: Puts Serena's instructions manual and its already-active project into the system prompt, and its tools in front, so Claude uses Serena without being asked

plugins.name: thinking-log
plugins.description: Shows Claude's streamed thinking summary as dim lines in the session transcript
